# # Dependency Trace: Jackson ObjectMapper through Spring Framework to Spring Boot

## Context

Jackson is the default JSON library in the Spring ecosystem. When a developer
registers a custom Jackson Module bean in a Spring Boot application, it should
be auto-detected and applied to all REST endpoints. But the path from bean
definition to actual serialization crosses three repositories:

- Jackson provides ObjectMapper and the Module registration API
- Spring Framework provides Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder and MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter
- Spring Boot provides JacksonAutoConfiguration that wires everything together

## Task

Trace how a custom Jackson Module bean flows from Spring Boot autoconfiguration
through Spring Framework's builder into Jackson's ObjectMapper.

## Repos in Workspace

- `/workspace/jackson-databind/` -- jackson-databind 2.15.2 (upstream library)
- `/workspace/spring-framework/` -- Spring Framework 6.0.11 (intermediary)
- `/workspace/spring-boot/` -- Spring Boot 3.1.2 (consumer/autoconfigurer)

## Expected Output

Write `/workspace/DEPENDENCY_TRACE.md` containing:

1. Key classes and methods in jackson-databind for module registration
2. How Spring Framework's Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder and MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter integrate with Jackson
3. How Spring Boot's JacksonAutoConfiguration auto-detects and registers Module beans
4. The complete class/method chain from Module bean to REST serialization

# Dependency Trace: Jackson Module Bean → REST Serialization

## 1. Jackson-Databind: Module Registration API

**Repository:** `github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2`

### `Module` (abstract class)

[`src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/Module.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2/-/blob/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/Module.java)

`Module` is the abstract extension point developers implement. Key contract:

| Method | Line | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `getModuleName()` | L39 | Human-readable name; required non-null |
| `version()` | L46 | Module version; required non-null |
| `getTypeId()` | L61 | Identity key for deduplication; defaults to `getClass().getName()` |
| `setupModule(SetupContext)` | L76 | **Core hook** — called by `ObjectMapper` during registration; module installs serializers, deserializers, type modifiers via callback methods |
| `getDependencies()` | L86 | Other modules that must be registered first |

The inner interface [`Module.SetupContext`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2/-/blob/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/Module.java?L103) exposes `addSerializers`, `addDeserializers`, `addBeanSerializerModifier`, etc. Each callback directly mutates the owning `ObjectMapper`'s internal factories (`_serializerFactory`, `_deserializationContext._factory`).

### `ObjectMapper.registerModule(Module)`

[`ObjectMapper.java` L842–L879](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2/-/blob/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/ObjectMapper.java?L842-L879)

1. Validates `getModuleName()` and `version()` are non-null.
2. **Recursively registers dependencies** from `getDependencies()` (L858).
3. Checks `MapperFeature.IGNORE_DUPLICATE_MODULE_REGISTRATIONS` against `_registeredModuleTypes` (`LinkedHashSet`) — returns early if already registered (L863–L876).
4. Calls `module.setupModule(new Module.SetupContext() { ... })` with an anonymous context that delegates every callback into the `ObjectMapper`'s internals (L879). This is the moment serializers/deserializers are installed.

### `findModules()` / `registerModules()`

[`ObjectMapper.java` L1114–L1166](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/jackson-databind--jackson-databind-2.15.2/-/blob/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/ObjectMapper.java?L1114-L1166)

- `findModules(ClassLoader)` (L1127): discovers modules via `ServiceLoader<Module>` from `META-INF/services`.
- `findAndRegisterModules()` (L1164): convenience wrapper — `registerModules(findModules())`.
- Spring Framework calls `objectMapper.registerModules(list)` directly from its builder; the ServiceLoader path is available but not used by default in Spring Boot.

---

## 2. Spring Framework: Builder and HTTP Message Converter

**Repository:** `github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11`

### `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder`

[`Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java)

#### `modules(Module...)` — [L536–L551](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java?L536-L551)
Sets an explicit exhaustive list. Sets `findModulesViaServiceLoader=false` and `findWellKnownModules=false` — **suppresses all auto-detection**. Not used by Spring Boot.

#### `modulesToInstall(Module...)` — [L583–L587](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java?L583-L587)
**The method Spring Boot's customizer uses.** Sets `findWellKnownModules=true` so Spring still auto-detects JSR-310/Joda-Time modules and adds the supplied list on top.

#### `build()` — [L691–L703](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java?L691-L703)
Creates a fresh `ObjectMapper`, delegates to `configure(objectMapper)`.

#### `configure(ObjectMapper)` — [L710–L793](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.java?L710-L793)

```
1. if findModulesViaServiceLoader → ObjectMapper.findModules()          (ServiceLoader)
   else if findWellKnownModules   → registerWellKnownModulesIfAvailable() (JSR-310, etc.)

2. this.modules → registerModule(module, modulesToRegister)
   [MultiValueMap keyed by typeId; set() for typed modules, add() for anonymous]

3. this.moduleClasses → instantiate → add to modulesToRegister

4. objectMapper.registerModules(resolvedList)   ← hands off to Jackson

5. Apply: dateFormat, locale, timeZone, annotationIntrospector, propertyNamingStrategy,
          defaultTyping, serializationInclusion, filters, mixIns, visibilities,
          features, handlerInstantiator, post-configurer
```

### `MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter`

[`MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java)

Extends `AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter`. Supports `application/json` and `application/*+json` (L72).

- **Default constructor** ([L62–L64](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L62-L64)): `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.json().build()` — standalone, no Boot customizers. Not the path in a Spring Boot app.
- **`ObjectMapper` constructor** ([L71–L73](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L71-L73)): receives the already-configured `ObjectMapper` bean. This is what Spring Boot's `HttpMessageConvertersAutoConfiguration` uses.

### `AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter` — Serialization / Deserialization

[`AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java)

**Reading** ([L349–L408](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L349-L408)):
```
read() / readInternal()
  → readJavaType()
      → selectObjectMapper(clazz, contentType)
      → objectMapper.reader().forType(javaType)   OR   readerWithView(view).forType(javaType)
      → objectReader.readValue(inputStream)
```

**Writing** ([L439–L494](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-framework--v6.0.11/-/blob/spring-web/src/main/java/org/springframework/http/converter/json/AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.java?L439-L494)):
```
writeInternal()
  → selectObjectMapper(clazz, contentType)
  → objectMapper.getFactory().createGenerator(outputStream, encoding)
  → objectMapper.writer()   OR   writerWithView(view)
  → objectWriter.writeValue(generator, value)   ← module serializers invoked here
```

Module registration does not happen per request — only the already-installed serializers are invoked.

## 3. Spring Boot: JacksonAutoConfiguration

**Repository:** `github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2`

[`JacksonAutoConfiguration.java`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java) — `@AutoConfiguration @ConditionalOnClass(ObjectMapper.class)`

### 3a. Module bean detection — `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizerConfiguration` ([L172–L343](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L172-L343))

```java
@Bean
StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer standardJacksonObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer(
        JacksonProperties jacksonProperties,
        ObjectProvider<Module> modules) {     // ← ALL Module beans in the application context
    return new StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer(
            jacksonProperties, modules.stream().toList());
}
```

`ObjectProvider<Module>` collects every `Module` bean — including any developer-defined ones. `StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer.customize()` ([L202](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L202)) eventually calls `configureModules()` ([L306–L308](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L306-L308)):

```java
private void configureModules(Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder) {
    builder.modulesToInstall(this.modules.toArray(new Module[0]));
}
```

### 3b. Builder bean — `JacksonObjectMapperBuilderConfiguration` ([L148–L170](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L148-L170))

```java
@Bean @Scope("prototype") @ConditionalOnMissingBean
Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder jacksonObjectMapperBuilder(
        ApplicationContext applicationContext,
        List<Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer> customizers) {
    Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder = new Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder();
    builder.applicationContext(applicationContext);
    customize(builder, customizers);   // applies all customizers in Ordered sequence
    return builder;
}
```

`StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer` has order `0` ([L197](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L197)).

### 3c. ObjectMapper bean — `JacksonObjectMapperConfiguration` ([L123–L134](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/spring-boot--v3.1.2/-/blob/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/org/springframework/boot/autoconfigure/jackson/JacksonAutoConfiguration.java?L123-L134))

```java
@Bean @Primary @ConditionalOnMissingBean
ObjectMapper jacksonObjectMapper(Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder builder) {
    return builder.createXmlMapper(false).build();
}
```

### Additional automatically-registered Module beans

| Bean | Line | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `JsonComponentModule` | L100 | Scans `@JsonComponent`-annotated beans |
| `JsonMixinModule` | L114 | Scans `@JsonMixin`-annotated types |
| `ParameterNamesModule` | L140 | Conditional on `jackson-module-parameter-names` classpath |

All are registered as `Module` beans and flow through the same `ObjectProvider<Module>` pipeline.

## 4. Complete Class/Method Chain

```
Developer defines:
  @Bean
  public MyModule myModule() { return new MyModule(); }
  // MyModule extends com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.Module

=== Spring Boot application context startup =====================================

JacksonAutoConfiguration (spring-boot)
  |
  +-- Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizerConfiguration
  |     +-- @Bean StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer(
  |                  JacksonProperties,
  |                  ObjectProvider<Module>)         <-- collects MyModule + all Module beans
  |
  +-- JacksonObjectMapperBuilderConfiguration
  |     +-- @Bean Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder  [prototype]
  |               .applicationContext(ctx)
  |               .customize(List<Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer>)
  |                     +-- StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer.customize(builder)
  |                          +-- configureFeatures / configureVisibility / ...
  |                          +-- configureModules(builder)
  |                                +-- builder.modulesToInstall([MyModule, JsonComponentModule, ...])
  |                                           (this.modules set; findWellKnownModules=true)
  |
  +-- JacksonObjectMapperConfiguration
        +-- @Bean ObjectMapper  (primary singleton)
                  <- builder.createXmlMapper(false).build()
                        +-- Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.build()        (spring-framework)
                              +-- new ObjectMapper()
                              +-- configure(objectMapper)
                                    |
                                    +-- registerWellKnownModulesIfAvailable()  (JSR-310, etc.)
                                    |
                                    +-- objectMapper.registerModules([MyModule, ...])
                                          +-- ObjectMapper.registerModule(MyModule)  (jackson-databind)
                                                +-- registerModule(dep) for getDependencies()
                                                +-- dedup check via _registeredModuleTypes
                                                +-- MyModule.setupModule(new SetupContext() {
                                                      addSerializers(s)
                                                        -> _serializerFactory mutated
                                                      addDeserializers(d)
                                                        -> _deserializationContext._factory mutated
                                                      addBeanSerializerModifier(m)
                                                        -> _serializerFactory mutated
                                                      ...
                                                    })

=== HTTP request arrives ========================================================

DispatcherServlet
  +-- RequestMappingHandlerAdapter
        +-- selects MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter
              (constructed with the primary ObjectMapper singleton above)

MappingJackson2HttpMessageConverter (spring-framework)
  +-- AbstractJackson2HttpMessageConverter.writeInternal(object, type, outputMessage)
          +-- selectObjectMapper(clazz, contentType)       -> primary ObjectMapper
          +-- objectMapper.getFactory().createGenerator(outputStream, encoding)
          +-- objectMapper.writer()                         -> ObjectWriter
          +-- objectWriter.writeValue(generator, value)
                +-- Jackson invokes MyModule's registered serializers
                    (installed into _serializerFactory during setupModule() at startup)
```

---

## 5. Key Design Notes

**`modulesToInstall` vs `modules`**: Spring Boot uses `modulesToInstall()` (not `modules()`) so that Spring's well-known module auto-detection (JSR-310, Joda-Time) still runs alongside the application's beans. Calling `modules()` would suppress that detection entirely.

**Two-tier deduplication**: Spring's builder deduplicates by `typeId` in a `MultiValueMap` before calling `registerModules()`. Jackson deduplicates again inside `registerModule()` using `_registeredModuleTypes` when `IGNORE_DUPLICATE_MODULE_REGISTRATIONS` is enabled. Last registration wins per `typeId`.

**`@ConditionalOnMissingBean` escape hatches**: All three auto-configured beans (`ObjectMapper`, `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder`, `StandardJackson2ObjectMapperBuilderCustomizer`) are conditional. Declaring your own bean of the matching type suppresses the auto-configuration for that tier.

**Thread safety**: `ObjectMapper` is a mutable singleton but modules mutate it only at startup via `setupModule()`. At request time, `objectMapper.writer()` returns an immutable `ObjectWriter` snapshot — safe for concurrent use.

**`@JsonComponent` and `@JsonMixin`**: Handled by `JsonComponentModule` and `JsonMixinModule` respectively, both registered as `Module` beans flowing through the identical pipeline as any developer-defined module.
